title: The Midrashim Transform M — canonical instances

lineage.title: The Revelation Room: Ground Truth and Algorithmic Unfolding
THE SHARK ARK: SOURCE COMPRESSION — Holographic Kernel

canary: the midrashim transform winds both directions through the Johannine aperture
claim_discipline: This does not claim to demonstrate historical fact. It demonstrates that a competing inference — compositional priority of the Apocalypse — accounts for structural features of the NT corpus, and renders that inference operable. The comparison is between inferences. The burden is symmetrical.
falsification: Identify NT passages that cannot be derived from Revelation through any plausible transform — these are the counterevidence. The transform graph is the object to be broken, not merely admired.

transforms.name: Lampstands → Ecclesiology

steps: from visual symbol to theological argument
